svg.title: Claude model releases in 2026 by tier
svg.desc: A horizontal timeline from January to October 2026 with three lanes. The Mythos tier shows Preview in April, version 5 in June and 5.1 in September. The Opus lane shows 4.6 in February, 4.7 in April, 4.8 in May, 5 in July and 5.5 in September. The Sonnet lane shows 4.6 in February, 5 in June and 5.5 in September.
